# PaginationInput.count property

Total rows in the set, used only to place a negative `limit`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
count?: number;
```

## Remarks

Nothing validates it against the real total, and it is ignored entirely for a positive `limit`<!-- -->.
